WITH filtered_sales AS (
    SELECT cs_order_number, cs_item_sk, cs_warehouse_sk,
           CASE WHEN (CAST(d_date AS DATE) < CAST('2001-05-02' AS DATE)) THEN cs_sales_price - COALESCE(cr_refunded_cash, 0) ELSE 0 END AS sales_before,
           CASE WHEN (CAST(d_date AS DATE) >= CAST('2001-05-02' AS DATE)) THEN cs_sales_price - COALESCE(cr_refunded_cash, 0) ELSE 0 END AS sales_after
    FROM catalog_sales 
    LEFT OUTER JOIN catalog_returns ON cs_order_number = cr_order_number AND cs_item_sk = cr_item_sk
    JOIN date_dim ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
),
grouped_sales AS (
    SELECT w_state, i_item_id,
           SUM(sales_before) AS total_sales_before,
           SUM(sales_after) AS total_sales_after
    FROM filtered_sales
    JOIN warehouse ON cs_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN item ON i_item_sk = cs_item_sk
    WHERE i_current_price BETWEEN 0.99 AND 1.49 AND d_date BETWEEN CAST('2001-04-02' AS DATE) AND CAST('2001-06-01' AS DATE)
    GROUP BY w_state, i_item_id
)
SELECT * 
FROM grouped_sales
ORDER BY w_state, i_item_id
LIMIT 100
